title: Allow dependency build scripts pnpm skipped, and run them

packages.description: npm package names whose install scripts may run (comma-separated: --packages=sharp,@swc/core). Each must be installed (listed in pnpm-lock.yaml).

apply.description: Allow the builds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and run `pnpm rebuild` for them. Without it (default) the generator shows what would change and writes nothing. Ignored when Nx's own --dry-run is set.
